description: This file implements a GStreamer source element class 'GstRialtoSrc' for the Rialto media framework, including methods for handling URI setting, message processing, state changes, and setup of media pipelines with optional DRM and payloader components. It also includes factory methods for creating and managing instances of the source object.

classes.name: GstRialtoSrc
classes.description: A custom GStreamer source element class for Rialto, handling URI management, message processing, and pipeline setup.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: A factory and manager class for creating and initializing GStreamer source objects within Rialto.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcUriGetType
methods.description: Returns the URI type for the source, which is 'GST_URI_SRC'.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetProtocols
methods.description: Returns the supported URI protocols, which is 'rialto'.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetUri
methods.description: Retrieves the current URI set for the source.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcSetUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the source, only allowed in states below PAUSED.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcHandleMessage
methods.description: Handles GStreamer messages such as EOS, forwarding or processing as needed.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcChangeState
methods.description: Manages state transitions, including starting/stopping async operations.

methods.name: GstSrc::initSrc
methods.description: Initializes the source element, registering it if not already registered.

methods.name: GstSrc::setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds appsrc, decryptor, payloader, and queue elements to the pipeline, setting up the media stream.

methods.name: GstSrc::allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Finalizes the addition of appsrc pads and signals completion.

methods.name: GstSrc::createPayloader
methods.description: Creates a payloader element, specifically 'svppay', if available.
